description: This file defines the RedirectMiddleware class for handling HTTP redirects in GuzzleHttp, including redirect logic, tracking, and request modification.

classes.name: RedirectMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling HTTP redirects, including redirect checks, request modifications, and tracking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the next handler callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the request, applies redirect logic if allowed, and returns a Promise.

methods.name: checkRedirect
methods.description: Checks if a response indicates a redirect and processes it accordingly.

methods.name: withTracking
methods.description: Adds redirect history headers to the response for tracking.

methods.name: guardMax
methods.description: Ensures the number of redirects does not exceed the maximum allowed.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request for redirection, including method, headers, and URI.

methods.name: redirectUri
methods.description: Resolves and validates the redirect URI based on the Location header.
